knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEYED: File has 5 sorries, 1 axiom (open conjecture). Good structure with clean definitions. Key insight: series converges by subseries comparison - since a_n are distinct naturals, sum a_n/2^{a_n} <= sum m/2^m = 2.
insights: series_converges: key insight is subseries comparison. Since a_n are distinct naturals (strict mono), sum a_n/2^{a_n} is a subseries of sum_{m=0}^inf m/2^m which converges to 2
fastGrowth_of_gapsToInfinity: if gaps d_k -> inf, then a_n >= a_0 + (n-N)*M for large n, so a_n/n -> inf. Needs Tendsto API work in Lean
fastGrowth_of_superlogarithmic: direct from a_n/n >= C*sqrt(log n * log log n) -> inf. Needs Tendsto compositions for sqrt/log
irrational_of_gaps_to_infinity: deep result from [Er74b]. Proof controls denominators in rational approximations using gap growth. NOT Aristotle-suitable.
irrational_of_superlogarithmic: refinement of gaps result using Diophantine approximation estimates. NOT Aristotle-suitable.
No sorry is suitable for Aristotle (all require analysis/Filter Tendsto API, not simple algebra)
